items.title: R$^2$Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary_zh: 在训练中按反馈共演化编排模型与版本化技能；部署时不携带技能。
items.summary_en: Co-evolves Director weights and versioned skills using execution feedback during training; deployment uses no skills.

items.title: CEPO: A General Framework for Improving Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary_zh: 用执行反馈分别修订协调者与执行器提示，经验证集选择后用于后续任务。
items.summary_en: Uses execution feedback to revise coordinator and executor prompts separately, selecting prompts on validation tasks for subsequent use.

items.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
items.summary_zh: 策展任务与轨迹以修订提示和 Harness 代码，迭代保留候选并按验证表现选优。
items.summary_en: Curates tasks and trajectories for feedback-driven prompt and harness-code revisions, carries candidates through iterations, and selects final versions by validation performance.

items.title: EvoTeam: Multi-Agent Collaboration via Evolving Teams
items.summary_zh: 依据执行反馈更新团队规则和技能，保留改动供后续团队协作与任务复用。
items.summary_en: Uses execution feedback to revise team rules and procedural skills, retaining updates for subsequent collaboration and tasks.

items.title: Mage-VL-Cowork: A Full Training Recipe to Learn Hybrid Computer Use From Evolved Harnesses
items.summary_zh: 以执行反馈演化冻结教师的 Harness，再固定该版本生成学生训练轨迹。
items.summary_en: Evolves a frozen teacher’s harness using execution feedback, then reuses the selected version to generate student training trajectories.

items.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 梳理视频 Harness 演化，并区分产物修复、跨任务保留和改进过程更新。
items.summary_en: Surveys video-harness evolution, separating output repair, retained cross-task changes, and updates to the improvement procedure.

items.title: MemSteer: Turning User Histories into Supervision for Agent Memory Optimization
items.summary_zh: 依据执行失败诊断修订存储、检索与上下文设计，经验证择优保留，并冻结设计跨基准复用。
items.summary_en: Revises storage, retrieval, and context designs using execution diagnostics, retains validation improvements, and transfers frozen designs across benchmarks.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.summary_zh: 用执行反馈和配对检验演化冻结教师的工具与恢复逻辑，再蒸馏小模型。
items.summary_en: Evolves a frozen teacher’s tools and recovery logic with execution feedback and paired tests, then distills a compact model.

items.title: RoboArchitect: Automating the Design of Robotic Agents with Persistent Memory
items.summary_zh: 在仿真中用轨迹反馈修订冻结策略外的控制代码，并在留出任务评估。
items.summary_en: Uses rollout feedback to revise control code around a frozen robotic policy, evaluating retained harnesses on held-out tasks in simulation.

items.title: ParetoSaddler: Pareto-Guided Optimization of Agent Harnesses for Quality and Cost
items.summary_zh: 用质量与成本反馈筛选 Harness 更新，并保留已完成开发评估的候选供后续优化。
items.summary_en: Uses quality and cost feedback to promote revised harnesses and retains candidates evaluated on development tasks for later optimization.

items.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
items.summary_zh: 将失败轨迹转成操作技能，经独立测试和修订后保留，供后续适用任务复用。
items.summary_en: Turns failed traces into procedural skills, tests and revises them with a separate agent, then retains them for later applicable tasks.

items.title: Recursa: Toward Recursively Self-Improving Foundation Model Systems
items.summary_zh: 根据失败反馈修订指令和技能，经过回归检查后合并，供后续任务复用。
items.summary_en: Revises instructions and procedural skills from failure feedback, validates changes for regressions, and merges them for subsequent tasks.

items.title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
items.short_title: Can Coding Agents Sustain Continual Evolution without Forgetting?
items.summary_zh: 评测编码 Harness 跨任务持续演化中的遗忘，跟踪提示、工具和执行逻辑变化。
items.summary_en: Studies forgetting during continual coding-harness evolution across tasks, tracking changes to prompts, tools, and execution logic.

items.title: Harness-S: Learning from Sibling Harnesses for Generalizable Agent Training
items.summary_zh: 按失败原因编辑并保留多种Harness，再用固定变体池辅助策略训练。
items.summary_en: Failure-guided edits create a reusable harness pool, which stays fixed while supporting policy training.

items.title: PyRUA-REAL: Robot Exploration and Adaptive Learning through RSI in the Real World
items.summary_zh: 执行反馈推动机器人技能代码修订与保留，既有技能库可用于新任务。
items.summary_en: Execution feedback revises reusable robot skills, and retained primitives support development on new tasks.

items.title: PromptOps: Iterative Prompt Optimization for LLM-as-a-Judge Systems
items.summary_zh: 依据逐步收到的评分反馈修订评审提示词，验证后的版本用于后续样本；实验反馈仍属理想化设置。
items.summary_en: Observed rating feedback updates judge prompts; validated revisions are reused on later samples under idealized feedback.

items.title: Beneath the Surface: What We Overlook When We Talk About Agent Evolution
items.summary_zh: 以冻结模型比较 Harness 演化，分别追踪收益、退化、部署成本和跨基准迁移，并审计候选保留机制。
items.summary_en: Compares Harness evolution with frozen models, tracking gains, regressions, deployment costs, transfer, and candidate retention.

items.title: EnvOpt: Automated Optimization for Agent Environments
items.summary_zh: 仅将其中按执行反馈保留的工具与访问接口优化纳入 Harness；普通环境文件重排不计入此范围。
items.summary_en: Only feedback-driven, retained tool and access-interface revisions qualify here as Harness components; ordinary environment restructuring does not.

items.title: ReferClaw: Disambiguating User Intent for Egocentric Assistance
items.summary_zh: 交互失败触发可复用澄清技能更新，并在空闲期优化责任模块适配器；变更只影响后续交互。
items.summary_en: Interaction failures update reusable clarification skills, while idle periods train the responsible adapter; updates affect later interactions.

items.title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
items.short_title: Learning the Task or Learning the Verifier? Rethinking Criteria Exposure in Embodied Self-Improvement
items.summary_zh: 冻结执行模型与底层原语，评测反馈驱动的技能库迭代，区分验证器适配与跨任务迁移。
items.summary_en: Evaluates feedback-driven skill-library revisions with a frozen actor, distinguishing verifier adaptation from cross-task transfer.

backlog.title: MoFlow: Multi-Objective Agentic Workflow Generation
backlog.summary_zh: MoFlow 根据实际执行的多目标反馈搜索多 Agent 工作流，修改算子、角色和分支循环，并保留候选前沿供后续偏好选择。开发与留出评测分开，在线搜索和离线复用的证据需要分别理解。
backlog.summary_en: MoFlow searches multi-agent workflows using multi-objective execution feedback, revising operators, roles and branching or loops while retaining a candidate frontier for later preference selection. Development and held-out evaluation are separated; online search and offline reuse provide distinct evidence.

backlog.title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations: Conserving Authority across Replacement, Forking, and Rollback
backlog.short_title: Authorization for Self-Modifying AI Agent Populations
backlog.summary_zh: 本文研究自修改软件 Agent 在替换、分叉和回滚时的授权继承，并用真实框架适配器检查变异后的权限约束。它属于 Harness 演化安全理论；适配器验证不等于自主开放式进化，本次也未复核形式证明。
backlog.summary_en: This work studies authorization inheritance when self-modifying software agents replace, fork or roll back, with framework adapters checking authority after mutations. It concerns Harness-evolution safety theory; adapter validation is not autonomous open-ended evolution, and this review does not recertify the formal proofs.

backlog.title: ST-Bench: A Spatial-Temporal Benchmark for Multi-Agent System Generation on Scientific Research Tasks
backlog.summary_zh: ST-Bench 包含在开发评分反馈下优化并跨查询复用的多 Agent 工作流，以及未参与优化的测试查询。作为 Harness 专项评测收录，不把其中一次性生成、固定提示或权重训练对照也称为递归改进。
backlog.summary_en: ST-Bench evaluates multi-agent workflows optimized with development-score feedback and reused across queries, including test queries not used in optimization. It is included as a Harness-focused evaluation; one-shot, fixed-prompt and weight-training baselines are not all recursive improvement methods.

backlog.title: Skill-V: Verifiable Self-Evolving Skill Library for Interactive Agents
backlog.summary_zh: Skill-V 根据环境反馈同时训练策略权重和修订外部技能契约，契约包含程序步骤、适用条件和可执行判据。通过回放检查的契约作为新版本供后续任务使用；声明式操作受限，不是任意生成代码，也未证明每条技能的因果效果。
backlog.summary_en: Skill-V uses environment feedback to train policy weights and revise external skill contracts containing procedures, applicability conditions and executable criteria. Contracts admitted by replay checks become new versions for later tasks; declarative operations are restricted, rather than arbitrary generated code, and each skill’s causal effect is not established.

backlog.title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
backlog.summary_zh: AgentSWE 评测编程 Agent 能否按开发反馈构建可交付的 Agent，包括提示、工具编排、状态管理和输出校验。最终交付快照冻结后再独立测试，可复用策略的证据与普通软件任务产物应区分。
backlog.summary_en: AgentSWE evaluates whether coding agents can use development feedback to build deployable agents, including prompts, tool orchestration, state management and output checks. Delivered snapshots are frozen for independent testing; reusable-policy evidence is distinguished from ordinary software-task outputs.

backlog.title: Cortex: Measurement-Gated Evolution and Pruning of Coding-Agent Skills and Rules
backlog.summary_zh: Cortex 把开发者纠正转成回放任务，用真实执行对照和脚本闸门决定是否保留或删除编码 Agent 的技能与规则。通过的工件进入后续任务的 Harness；主要实验来自合成仓库，真实项目未产生学习，强模型收益和隔离设计也有限制。
backlog.summary_en: Cortex turns developer corrections into replay tasks, using execution comparisons and scripted gates to retain or prune coding-agent skills and rules. Admitted artifacts enter the Harness used for later tasks; the main experiments use synthetic repositories, with no learning result on a real project and limitations for strong models and isolation.

backlog.title: Reels-RSI: Program-Level Self-Improvement for Code-Rendered Explainer Videos
backlog.summary_zh: Reels-RSI 将视频制作反馈沉淀为跨作品运行的检查规则和可修订的导演手册，且保留人工应用环节。论文承认首轮评价有位置偏差，后续改写也没有应用；收录的是 Harness 组件机制，不是普遍有效的自进化结论。
backlog.summary_en: Reels-RSI turns video-production feedback into checks used across productions and a revisable director playbook, retaining a human application step. The paper acknowledges position bias in the initial evaluation and leaves a later rewrite unapplied; inclusion concerns the Harness-component mechanism, not a general claim of successful self-improvement.

backlog.title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs: When a Small Model Is Enough
backlog.short_title: Compiling Expert Procedures into Verified Programs
backlog.summary_zh: PLVR 搜索外部工具调用控制程序，实际执行候选后依据教师动作距离和训练任务结果选择保留版本，冻结后用于新任务。程序依赖人工建立的原语和规则库，不是从零自动发现。
backlog.summary_en: PLVR searches external tool-control programs, executes candidates and selects retained versions using teacher-action distance and training-task outcomes before freezing them for new tasks. The programs rely on a manually constructed primitive and rule library, rather than discovery from scratch.

backlog.title: CarryOn: A Dual-Loop Harness for Personalized and Reliable Robot Assistance
backlog.summary_zh: CarryOn 根据执行失败修订恢复技能的控制参数和控制流，把通过检查的改动保存为下一版技能库。模型权重固定；论文中的累计失败重试不等同于独立留出集泛化。
backlog.summary_en: CarryOn revises recovery control parameters and control flow after execution failures, saving admitted changes as the next skill-library version. Model weights remain fixed; cumulative retries of failed episodes do not establish independent held-out generalization.

backlog.title: IRAH: Hierarchical Agentic Tree Search for Retrieval Pipeline Optimization
backlog.summary_zh: IRAH 根据真实检索评分反思并变异检索流水线配置，搜索检索器、切分器、重排器的结构和设置。优化查询选出的配置保留用于独立留出查询，不等于整个 Agent 自改代码或同步训练全部模型。
backlog.summary_en: IRAH reflects on retrieval scores and mutates retrieval-pipeline configurations, searching retriever, chunker and reranker structures and settings. Configurations selected on optimization queries are retained for independent held-out queries; this is not whole-agent self-rewriting or joint training of every model.

backlog.title: IF-MAP: Influence-Function-Inspired Agent Prioritization in Multi-Agent Systems
backlog.summary_zh: IF-MAP 用端到端执行损失选择值得改进的 Agent 节点，再由文本反馈优化器迭代该节点的提示。通过开发集检查的提示被保留用于后续测试，收录范围是反馈驱动的目标选择与提示优化组件。
backlog.summary_en: IF-MAP uses end-to-end execution loss to prioritize agent nodes, then iterates their prompts through a textual-feedback optimizer. Prompts admitted by development-set checks are retained for later testing; the included scope is feedback-driven target selection and prompt optimization.

backlog.title: HarnessRL: Co-Evolving Policies with a Just-in-Time Training Harness for Open-Ended RL
backlog.summary_zh: HarnessRL 在政策权重训练的同时，根据反馈迭代任务采样、rollout 指导和评分标准等外部训练接口。候选经当前冻结政策上的测量后准入并用于后续训练；这种阶段性冻结不代表模型权重始终固定。
backlog.summary_en: HarnessRL updates external training interfaces for task sampling, rollout guidance and rubrics alongside policy-weight training. Candidates are admitted after measurement against the currently frozen policy and retained for later training; this temporary freeze does not mean model weights remain fixed throughout.

backlog.title: SCOPE: Compiling Natural-Language Policies into Neurosymbolic Predicate Programs
backlog.summary_zh: SCOPE 将自然语言政策编译为外部谓词程序，根据执行跟踪和对抗样例修订抽取器、谓词及组合逻辑，并保留或回退候选。收录其策略执行 Harness 组件，标签池变化不等于模型权重训练。
backlog.summary_en: SCOPE compiles natural-language policies into external predicate programs, revising extractors, predicates and composition logic using execution traces and adversarial cases while retaining or reverting candidates. The included component is policy-enforcement Harness optimization; changes to a label pool are not model-weight training.

backlog.title: AgentOrch: How Close Can Global Orchestration Come to Step-by-Step Interaction?
backlog.summary_zh: AgentOrch 的 Replan 分支根据工具执行和控制流反馈重写完整工作流，并固定复用于同一流程的新输入。本次仅收录该工作流改进分支；另行进行的权重训练不能据此称为 Harness 共演化。
backlog.summary_en: The Replan branch of AgentOrch rewrites complete workflows from tool-execution and control-flow feedback, then reuses them unchanged on new inputs for the same procedure. Only this workflow-improvement branch is included; separate weight training does not establish Harness coevolution.

backlog.title: Batching the Reflective Optimization Loop: Parallel Proposals Make GEPA Faster and Better
backlog.summary_zh: 本文把 GEPA 的反思候选提出、执行和验证改为批量处理，持续更新被保留的候选前沿，并在留出任务上测试优化后的提示。属于 Harness 优化器组件改进，不能据此称为改进器自身递归演化。
backlog.summary_en: This work batches GEPA's reflective proposals, execution and validation, updating a retained candidate frontier and testing optimized prompts on held-out tasks. It improves a Harness-optimization component; it does not demonstrate recursive evolution of the optimizer itself.

intro.zh: 本期完成审查并获批准 20 篇论文：Harness / 脚手架 RSI 16 篇、评测、基准与归因 3 篇、理论与综述 1 篇。本期论文最多的方向为 Harness / 脚手架 RSI。
intro.en: This edition includes 20 reviewed and approved papers: Harness RSI: 16; Evaluation, benchmarks & attribution: 3; Theory & surveys: 1. Harness RSI has the most papers in this edition.
